name: Imperium Neuralis: Website Architect
tag: Analyzes your website, estimates what a better one could earn and generates the improved version.

scenarios.title: Audit and rebuild a service site
scenarios.ask: Our site gets {visitors} visitors a month and {conv}% become inquiries. Analyze it and build a better one.

inputs.label: Average value of a new client

steps: Analyzer
Scanned 14 sample pages: slow mobile load, no clear call to action above the fold, contact form 9 fields long.
Revenue model
Today: {=round(visitors * conv / 100)} inquiries a month. A typical lift after fixes like these is 20 to 50%.
Architect
Planned a 6-page site: home, services, proof, pricing guide, about, contact.
Builder
Generated the new pages with a 4-field form and a call button on every page.

result.title: New site plan
rows: Extra revenue if 1 in 4 become clients

followups: It's the middle of a common range for fixes like a shorter form and clearer calls to action. Your real result depends on your market and traffic.
Do we keep our domain and content?
Yes. The new site uses your domain, and your existing text and photos are reused where they still work.

scenarios.title: Online store checkout leaks
scenarios.ask: Our store gets {visitors} visitors a month and the average order is ${order}. Find where we lose buyers.
steps: Analyzer
Walked the purchase path. {cart}% add to cart, but 70% of carts are abandoned.
Diagnoser
Shipping cost appears only on the last step, and guest checkout is hidden.
Revenue model
Recovering 10% of abandoned carts adds {=round(visitors * cart / 100 * 0.7 * 0.1)} orders a month.
Builder
Generated a new cart and checkout layout with shipping shown up front.
followups: It's a conservative planning figure. Clear shipping costs and guest checkout are among the most common fixes for abandoned carts.
Yes. Run the new checkout for half your visitors and compare for two to four weeks.

scenarios.title: Quick site score
scenarios.ask: Score our {pages}-page website and tell me the top fixes.
steps: Crawler
Read all {pages} pages and checked links, images and forms.
Analyzer
Found {=max(2, round(pages * 0.4))} issues: missing page titles, large images and 3 broken links.
Prioritizer
Ranked fixes by effect on speed, search visibility and inquiries.
Builder
Offered to generate fixed versions of the top 5 pages.
followups: Speed, mobile layout, search basics like titles and descriptions, and how easy it is to contact you.
Yes. Each issue comes with plain steps. The builder is there if you'd rather have it done.
